# source: enumitem manual §3 (label and layout keys), §5 (\setlist and the
# optional-argument form on each list), §6 (\newlist family), §8 (resuming). A \newlist alone
# sets nothing: its lists set as the kind they copy, its \setlist keys before their own.
pre impl \setlist{itemsep=2pt}
pre impl \setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=2em}
pre inert:noop \newlist{steps}{enumerate}{3}
pre inert:noop \renewlist{itemize}{itemize}{4}
pre refuse:W0301 \setlistdepth{6}
body impl \begin{itemize}[leftmargin=2em]\item a\end{itemize}
body impl \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]\item a\end{enumerate}
body impl \begin{enumerate}[start=3]\item a\end{enumerate}
body impl \begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]\item a\end{itemize}
pre impl \setlist[enumerate]{label=\Roman*.}
pre impl \setlist{leftmargin=*}
body refuse:W0301 \restartlist{enumerate}
body impl x \begin{enumerate*}\item a \item b\end{enumerate*} y
body impl x \begin{itemize*}\item a \item b\end{itemize*} y
body impl \begin{enumerate}[series=s]\item a\end{enumerate}\begin{enumerate}[resume=s]\item b\end{enumerate}
body impl x \begin{description*}\item[a] b\end{description*} y
